column1: # The genetics colour table. BLESSED, not derived at build time.
# gen-sprites.py computes each variant colour and asserts it equals the row here, and
# FAILS the build on a source colour with no row -- so adding a per-line O or N override
# forces a human to bless five new values instead of silently inheriting whatever the
# helper produces. Regenerated only with `gen-sprites.py --bless`, whose diff a person
# reads and whose swatches land on the acceptance sheet.
# This is a REGRESSION LOCK on the pinned formula's output, not an independent proof
# that the formula is right. Nobody can validate 6B4E9E -> 69558D by reading hex; the
# art gate is where that question is actually answerable.

column4: N every line, the global default
